en.headline: Government proposes a new Wo Hop Shek crematorium for 2032
en.dek: A paper to LegCo puts the cost at about 2.03 billion dollars and says the site would add about 21,600 cremation sessions a year.
body: The government has proposed a new crematorium at Wo Hop Shek Cemetery, with commissioning targeted for 2032, according to a paper submitted to the Legislative Council.

The paper puts the preliminary cost of the proposed works at about 2.0334 billion dollars. The new crematorium would have 10 cremators and six ceremony halls, the government said. Newer equipment is expected to cut the average session from about 90 minutes to about 75 minutes, adding about 21,600 cremation sessions a year.
Other crematoria would also have their cremators replaced in stages, the government said, so that cremation capacity can meet demand at least until 2050.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department now runs six crematoria with 34 cremators, which can generally provide about 50,000 sessions a year, the paper said. It said utilisation was approaching saturation.

zh.headline: 政府建議和合石建新火葬場 預計2032年啟用
zh.dek: 立法會文件初步估算工程費用約20.3億元，新場設10個火化爐，每年可多提供約2.16萬節時段。
body: 政府建議在和合石墳場興建新火葬場，預計2032年啟用。提交立法會的文件指出，其他火葬場亦會分階段更換火化爐，以應付火化服務需求至少至2050年。
文件初步預計擬議工程費用約20億3340萬元。新火葬場設施包括10個全新火化爐及6個儀式禮堂。政府表示，新火化爐技術可把每節所需時間由現時平均約90分鐘縮短至約75分鐘，每年可額外提供約21600節火化時段。
文件提到，食環署現時轄下有6個火葬場，共設34個火化爐，每年一般可提供約5萬節火化時段，使用率已趨向飽和。
